name: Guahayona
description: Star of 5,079 K, 142 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: HAT-P-26 b crosses Guahayona as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: HAT-P-26
quotes.card: HAT-P-26 is a K-type main-sequence star located about 466 light-years away in the constellation of Virgo.
quotes.introduction: A survey in 2015 did not find any stellar companions in orbit around it, although a red dwarf companion with a temperature 4000+100−350 K is suspected on wide orbit.
